RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor is elected citywide. The City Council consists of nine members serving four-year terms; seven are elected by electoral districts, and two are elected in citywide at-large positions (referred to as Position 8 and Position 9). Other elected offices in Seattle include the City Attorney and Municipal Court judges.
